title: Couple Dirichlet fibres through shared gamma mass
statement: For positive a and nonnegative b, independent G_i~Gamma(a_i,1),H_i~Gamma(b_i,1),withGamma(0,1)=0, give X=G/sumG~Dir(a) andY=(G+H)/(sumG+sumH)~Dir(a+b). For b0>0 writeY=(1-R)X+RZ,R=sumH/(sumG+sumH),ER=b0/(a0+b0),so E||X-Y||1<=2b0/(a0+b0); ifb0=0 they coincide. Forb=e_i, exact E||X-Y||1=2(1-a_i/a0)/(a0+1). For coupled count indices n,nprime, usec_i=min(n_i,nprime_i),a=alpha+c,d1=|n-c|1,d2=|nprime-c|1. SharedGamma(a) with separate difference increments yields exact fibre marginals and conditional expectedL1<=min(2,2d1/(|alpha|+|c|+d1)+2d2/(|alpha|+|c|+d2)). Integrate over ANY coupling of the index laws. This is a conditional transportation bound, not continuous-latent TV, a total-degree-only estimate, an algorithm for the mixing indices or a finite-bit gamma sampler.
